title: Follon trusted acceptance reviewer key set
description: The keys whose signatures make an acceptance record count. An operator provisions and controls this file. Every record in a ledger root must be signed by a key listed here for the reviewer it names, or the audit fails, so an empty set passes only an empty root. A key is never removed: a reviewer who leaves stays listed, and a key that may no longer be trusted is marked revoked, which stops its acceptances counting and keeps its rejections. Each public key must be an Ed25519 point of the prime-order subgroup, and no two entries may share one. Version 1 sets, which had no status, are still read with every key active. Every audit and promotion receipt names the SHA-256 of the set it used.

public_key_hex.description: The 32-byte Ed25519 public key, as `follon-admin release-keygen` writes it in a trusted key file. A key of small order, such as the all-zero string, is refused.

status.description: active: the key's signatures count. revoked: the key still verifies what it signed, its acceptances no longer count, and its rejections still disqualify.
